question: Under a sustained 10 deg pitch tilt (nose-down vs nose-up), with the Step B JO encoder feeding the exact JO C/E sets, does the leg-MN DOWN-minus-UP rate contrast contain a JO-attributable part (beyond the matched JO-withheld contrast) whose pattern is consistent across CNS seeds?

sources.context: malecns_backend.live.coxa_push_response Trial/create_session with kind N, push 0 (hair-plate Step C A_ON, 20 live-v3 channels, tibia proprioception, no coxa channel, zero force)

jo_input.populations: Step B result dense_indices (C_left 31, C_right 22, E_left 157, E_right 110; 320 neurons)
jo_input.rule: every neural tick: d per side from the live state (gravity = current model.opt.gravity); rates by Step B zone_rates under the arm's assignment; set as external drive on the four sets; same Bernoulli equation and instance-local boundary as the hair plates
jo_input.schedule: proprioception (392) + hair plates (52) + JO (320), identical in every arm; uniforms drawn over the whole schedule every tick
jo_input.OFF: JO computed and recorded with the G1 assignment but withheld at the CNS boundary (external_drive_withheld_indices = JO)

tilt.operation: after stored state 5005 is captured (model record verified unchanged), set model.opt.gravity = R_y(phi) @ (0, 0, -9810), held to the end
tilt.meaning: DOWN equals pitching floor and fly 10 deg nose-down (gravity gains +x); UP equals 10 deg nose-up
tilt.rationale: inside Step B's validated +-30 deg grid; friction 1.0 >> tan 10 deg; comparable to the assisted-posture tilt (4-10 deg); declared, not tuned

arms.duration: 20000 physics / 4000 neural transitions each; fresh process each; run once

integrity.I1_complete: all 37 arms COMPLETE with 20001 samples and 4000 ticks
integrity.I2_reproduction: REPRO_N0_7 equals the local N0_7 raw arm (sha above) by coxa_offset_yoke.reproduces
integrity.I3_common_rng: within each seed, all six arms have identical external schedule and per-tick uniforms digests
integrity.I4_prefixes: within each seed and assignment, UP and DOWN have equal qpos and commands for stored states 0-5005 and equal fired lists for ticks with time_ms <= 500.0; within each seed, all six arms have equal state-0 qpos
integrity.I5_tilt_record: recorded gravity is (0,0,-9810) for states 0-5005 and exactly the declared rotated vector from 5006 on; event recorded with the unchanged model record; no applied body wrench and zero external/generalized applied maxima at every state
integrity.I6_jo_delivery: JO delivered only in G1/FLIP arms and only to the four sets; OFF arms deliver no JO event; each tick's recorded JO rates equal zone_rates(recorded d, assignment); at the first tick with time_ms > 500.5, d(DOWN) > d(UP) on both sides for each seed and each assignment (incl. OFF, recorded under G1)
integrity.I7_seeds: every arm records its seed; tick-1 uniforms of seeds 13-18 are pairwise different

physical_precondition.rule: in every OFF arm, the angle between the Thorax body z axis and -gravity_hat stays < 45 deg for every stored state in the window

measures.pools: bodymap muscles matching '^(.+) (T[123]) (left|right)$'; pool key '<T> <side> <class>' with class = actuator minus '_<T>_<side>'; pool ids = union of idx
measures.pool_inclusion: pool has >= 1 spike in the window in any of the 36 seed arms (sign-blind; fixed before the run)
measures.rate: spikes in window / pool size / 1.48 s (hair_plate_posture.rate)
measures.delta: Delta_a,s = rate(a_DOWN_s) - rate(a_UP_s) per included pool, a in {OFF, G1, FLIP}
measures.S: S_a,s = Delta_a,s - Delta_OFF,s for a in {G1, FLIP}
measures.rho: mean Pearson correlation of S_a,s over the 15 seed pairs; a pair with a zero-variance vector contributes 0
measures.sign_flip_test: for all 64 sign vectors sigma in {+-1}^6, rho_sigma = mean over pairs of sigma_i sigma_j corr_ij; p_a = #{rho_sigma >= rho_obs - 1e-12} / 64 (minimum 2/64)

reported_not_labelled: r_GF: Pearson correlation of seed-mean S_G1 and seed-mean S_FLIP (linearity check; additive responses give about -1; cannot identify zone sign)
mean |Delta_a,s| per arm type and seed; L2 norm of S_a,s
per-pool seed median of S and the count of seeds with positive S
descending neurons of types DNp73, DNp18, DNg29, pIP1, DNbe001 among Step A's descending_reached body_ids: DOWN-UP rate contrast per arm type and seed
tonic effect: mean leg-MN rate over included pools in G1_UP and FLIP_UP vs OFF_UP over 0-500 ms
body: mean and peak tilt relative to gravity, mean pitch and roll relative to gravity in the window, first stored state where G1_UP and OFF_UP qpos differ
per-side (left/right) MN contrasts, labelled with the reconstruction asymmetry; no left-minus-right difference is read as roll sensing

declared_interpretation.CONSISTENT: JO-encoded sustained pitch passes through the connectome to a reproducible leg-MN change beyond the other senses: an information path that balance would need; not corrective, not balance
declared_interpretation.WEAK_or_NO: a 10 deg tilt through this encoder does not give a reproducible leg-MN pattern over 1.5 s beyond the other senses; causes (chaotic divergence, small drive, indirect route) not distinguished; no rerun with larger tilt or more seeds without a new versioned protocol
declared_interpretation.assignments_disagree: reported as is; neither assignment is promoted

interpretation_limits: Modelled kinematic JO transduction; 120 Hz engineering scale; G1 label arbitrary.
Idealised step tilt by gravity rotation (floor and fly together, no rotational transient).
ON arms carry tonic JO input from t=0, so the OFF subtraction removes the other-senses tilt response only to first order.
Coxa MNs drive no joint (unmapped or CONDITIONAL); MN patterns are read out, acting only through the 20 admitted channels.
Right-side JO reconstruction far less connected; sets used as reconstructed.
No motor coordinate status change (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
single_run: All 37 arms run once after protocol, code and tests are committed and pushed; evaluated once.
